'''Thaedius Creed''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who lived during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Creed founded and lead the construction company [[CreedCon Construction]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he and a group of investors secured the rights to build a race track through the jungles of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. However, a group of his construction workers, who were building a bridge for the course, were captured by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Raik Muun]]. Creed sent a security team to find them, but they too disappeared. In order to find his missing employees, he sent the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[W2-7AY]] to find the [[Heroes of Cularin]] and request that they come and meet him at the [[CreedCon office]], in [[Hedrett]]. The heroes met with him and set out to find the missing workers.
